_=vOiVAxmmxaQHTYCixa: Captain! The enemy is right outside our base! *click to continue*
Get ready to fight! We cannot afford to risk our last base!
Young man, when was the last time you fought?
Do you still remember how to battle?
I should teach you again how to battle.
Use the arrow keys to move, and buy units by pressing the cards above.
for mobile players, press the buttons to move.
For a more detailed explanation, please read the instructions.
And, press the "Start Level" button to continue.
Got it?
Nmqgdya^)@-{$B6%}7b;
Heh... So you finally came.
Even my elite units couldn't stop you?
Well... I admit that you're strong. Very strong.
But no matter how strong you are, you are nothing compared to a God.
My power is far beyond your imagination.
No matter how hard you try, you'll just fall again and again.
I wonder how many times you will try before you give up?
Heh heh heh...
Young man... Please listen to my words carefully.
That mage is strong... But if you use the techniques that you learned before,
You'll have a chance to defeat him.
The cards you choose at the beginning is very important.
And, beware of his magic.
That's all I have to tell you.
Good Luck.
Captain! We've successfully defend the enemy's attack!
Now the enemy is escaping to north-east!
We chase! Don't let the enemy escape!
Young man, just to tell you, you got a new unit, which is miner.
Each time you finish a level, you will get more units to use in battles.
You can only bring 6 units at most to a battle, so please think carefully about what units you bring to a battle,
To maximize the power of the units.
You can change your deck by pressing the top left button with a gear inside it,
Then press the "Deck" button.
You can also save your current progress, or load your progress before, by pressing the Save/Load button.
But beware, it will only save your current level, difficulty, and mobile mode.
It will not save the deck that you made, because the creator is too lazy.
If you think the levels are too difficult, you can press the "Difficultly" button to change to easy mode.
And if you're up for a challenge, try hard mode.
Crazy mode... you don't wanna mess with it.
And finally, you can change to mobile mode by pressing the "Mobile" button.
That's all I want to tell you... You can discover all the things by yourself.
Captain! Our scouts reported that the enemy were setting up a small base on the grassland after the bridge.
But, our reinforcements are still on the way.
Should we attack them directly or wait for the reinforcements?
Hmmm...
We should attack directly while the enemies are still unprepared!
Yes sir! We will be prepared as soon as possible!
Hmmph. Young man, try using the new cards 'scout' and 'knight'.
I have a feeling that the upcoming battle will be tough...
they will definitely give you a big support.
Captain! Our scouts reported that they found a magic barrier protecting the dark forest, our way to Kharaz's castle!
Did the scouts find anyway to break the barrier?
Sorry, captain. The scouts didn't find anyway to break it.
Hmm... I should ask the old wizard about this.
Hmmpp... It will need much energy for the barrier to work.
I'm sure that Kharaz will not have this much power even he has the dragon's crystal.
So, he must have get the energy from the EG. mountain, which is known for having much energy crystals.
We should get to the EG. mountain immediately...
But before that, I have something to get at the Mach. port.
It will definitely help you at future battles...
Captain! We are at the entrance of Mach. port!
Our scouts reported that it is well guarded by the enemies.
They also reported that the enemies seem to have some kind of machines...
The enemies must be defending something important.
No matter what it is, it should give us a great advantage, just like what the wizard said.
Prepare for battle!
Hmmm. Young man, you discovered a red card.
Red cards are the strongest cards in the game.
There are 4 red cards in total, each have a great advantage on different point.
You got Golem this time, which is great at defense.
Good luck finding the other red cards.
Captain! The enemy's base is destroyed!
There are some who escaped by the ship. Should we chase?
Our main objective is to kill Kharaz. We shouldn't waste time to do that.
We should prepare for attacking EG. mountain through the ninja village.
The scouts we sent were all gone, so we know nothing about it.
We should be well-prepared...
Hmmw, young man, here's a spell card, which was what the enemy is protecting.
In a battle, you can use spell cards to strike the enemy, save you from danger, or even turn the tables around.
Spell cards are free to use in a battle, but, it cost time to recharge.
Please take good use of them...
Captain, we're at the foot of the EG. mountain.
Our scout reported that they saw a huge energy crystal there.
So that's the thing which is supporting the magic barrier at the dark forest.
We're getting closer to success...did the scouts get any information of the enemies there?
Sorry captain, the scouts said that they can't see anything but the crystal because of the snowstorm.
We have no time to send another scout to investigate. We'll just attack directly!
Young man, there's something I wanna tell you.
I lived on the EG. mountain before, so I know how dangerous that place is.
You'll need to bring the mighty shield to this battle for sure...
Captain, we've successfully destroyed the energy crystal.
We're sending scouts to see if the magic barrier is destroyed.
But our base sent us a message, which is that they saw a ship of the enemy's moving towards them.
What should we do. Captain?
We're now too far away from our base.
Even if we rush back to our base now, it'll still take a long time.
Not mentioning that our most important task now is to kill Kharaz.
But I have faith in them. I'm sure that they will defeat the enemies.
As a leader, I trust my army no matter what.
Good news, Captain, our base had sent a message to us.
They said they have won the battle... and the base is safe.
No civilian was hurt by the battle.
Great. Now, we only have to defeat Kharaz, and the problems will be solved-once and for all.
Our base is also the place where we settle the civilians affected by the war.
So it will be a big problem if we lose our base.
Young man.
We're here- at the forest. Where monsters lived, where darkness gathered.
Affected by Kharaz's magic power, the trees grow continuously, the sky darkens rapidly.
The following battles will be stressful. You've had nothing to lose-but not now.
We can't dare-can't afford to lose all our progress again.
We are on the road to success. Don't give up just yet. Not now.
We are on the road to success. Don't give up just yet. Not now.
Good luck, young man.
